sources.entry: macho-browser - Browser for macOS Mach-O binaries.

summary.one_liner: A macOS application for browsing the contents of Mach-O binaries such as executables, shared libraries, and object files, offering a graphical alternative to the otool and nm command-line tools.
summary.what_it_does: Mach-O Browser is a Mac application for inspecting Mach-O (Mach Object) files, including executables, shared libraries, and intermediate object files. The README says it aims to provide similar functionality to the otool and nm command-line tools, but through the Aqua graphical interface of macOS. The README is brief and does not list specific views, panels, or detailed features beyond browsing file contents. It points to a home location and a latest-release page for downloads.
use_cases: inspect a Mach-O executable on macOS
browse symbols in a shared library
explore object file contents without the terminal
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the project's releases page and open the application on macOS
notable: Graphical front end for otool and nm-style inspection of Mach-O files
Covers executables, shared libraries, and intermediate object files
Native macOS app using the Aqua interface
caveats: Runs only on macOS, since it targets Mach-O binaries and the Aqua interface
README is brief and gives no build instructions or detailed feature list
